ev.q: to kill Ravan, the evil king of Lanka and establish dharma
his yagna is disturbed by some demons
Lord Vishnu decides to incarnate on earth as Ram
is a role model to his three younger brothers
Ram and Sita meet at Pushp vatika and fall in love at first sight
in the battle that follows, Shri Ram kills the whole army
Unable to bear the pain of separation from his son, Dashrath dies of grief
